articles.title: Canadian diplomats barred interacting with US midterm candidates: Reports
articles.summary: Canada has allegedly barred its diplomats from interacting with U.S. midterm candidates to avoid any allegations of election interference from the Trump administration, according to multiple reports. Written guidance issued earlier this week reportedly ordered Canadian officials based in the U.S. not to meet with candidates — or even be in the same room with…
articles.body:
Canada has allegedly barred its diplomats from interacting with U.S. midterm candidates to avoid any allegations of election interference from the Trump administration, according to multiple reports.

Written guidance issued earlier this week reportedly ordered Canadian officials based in the U.S. not to meet with candidates — or even be in the same room with them — without special permission, Bloomberg first reported Thursday , citing people familiar with the matter.

The Hill has reached out to the Canadian Foreign Ministry and the Canadian Embassy in Washington, D.C., for comment.

Under the new rule, Canadian diplomats can still meet with U.S. lawmakers not seeking reelection but cannot appear in photos alongside them or other American elected officials, sources told Bloomberg. The ban remains in effect until Election Day.

Reports surrounding this guidance came a day after the U.S. Embassy released a memo accusing Canadian politicians of trying to interfere in American elections. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney and Ontario Premier Doug Ford rejected these claims, The Associated Press reported.

The embassy’s fact sheet to Canadian politicians pointed specifically to the country’s industry minister, Mélanie Joly — who talked publicly about Washington’s duties against Ottawa impacting Republican states and contributed to the release of an anti-tariff ad quoting former President Reagan, which aired during the 2025 World Series.

Embassy officials also said in the memo that 11 Canadians had been charged in connection with illegally voting in U.S. elections between 2012 and 2026.

Canada has 130 Canadian diplomats and 254 federal employees, along with 356 American staffers, working on diplomatic missions in the U.S., CBC reported in July . They operate across 12 consulates across the country, from Boston to Los Angeles.

The move comes after trade negotiations between the U.S. and Canada fell apart in August. Trump hit Carney with 50 percent tariffs on about $20 billion in Canadian goods. The prime minister swiftly retaliated with taxes he said would “match Washington’s new tariffs dollar for dollar in order to protect Canadian workers, farmers, families and businesses.”

Carney said Wednesday Trump’s tariffs have raised costs for Americans, and he spoke with the president for “quite some time” about these issues. He and Ontario Premier Doug Ford rejected any claims of Canadian interference with the midterms.

U.S. Ambassador to Canada Pete Hoekstra said earlier this month U.S. officials are “closely watching” the actions of Canada’s politicians for any possible election meddling, CBC reported . J o ly clapped back, saying Canada would never interfere and would “never accept that also being done to us in Canada.”

articles.title: El Salvador sends troops to Haiti to rescue four service members, source says
articles.summary: El Salvador has deployed troops to Haiti to try to rescue four Salvadoran service members believed to have been captured by Haitian gangs, according to a spokesperson for a UN-authorized multinational security mission in Haiti known as the Gang Suppression Force (GSF).
articles.body: El Salvador has deployed troops to Haiti to try to rescue four Salvadoran service members believed to have been captured by Haitian gangs, according to a spokesperson for a UN-authorized multinational security mission in Haiti known as the Gang Suppression Force (GSF). The missing service members, described as non-combatant aviation technicians that were supporting the GSF mission, were ambushed by gangs on October 18, Salvadoran officials have said. The GSF has been carrying out a dayslong operation to try to find them. The effort has resulted in armed clashes that have left at least seven gang members dead and four GSF personnel wounded, the GSF has said. A spokesperson for the security mission confirmed to CNN on Thursday that Salvadoran troops had arrived in Haiti to support the effort. The Miami Herald first reported the 100-strong deployment. El Salvador has not commented on specific details of the mission. It comes a day after Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele announced that his country had launched an unspecified “military operation” to rescue the missing men. Bukele, who has carried out a brutal crackdown on gangs in his own country, warned Haitian gang members that they would face a more severe response if they didn’t release the service members alive. “And do not take our word for empty threats. We have already finished with the gangs in El Salvador, and we can finish with you too,” he said on X. Gang leader Lanmo Sanjou issued a response to Bukele on Thursday, filming himself with large quantities of ammunition and warning that his group would “fight to stay alive.” The GSF was established by the UN Security Council in 2025 to help Haiti fight the gangs plaguing the country. According to the resolution adopted at that time, the force consists of 5,500 military or police personnel and 50 civilians from various nations. El Salvador is one of the countries that agreed to provide personnel. Bukele says their primary job is to carry out medical evacuations.

articles.title: Teen dies after falling from moving carnival ride as questions mount over safety
articles.summary: A teenage girl, 18, fell from the "El Péndulo" carnival ride while it was in motion at a Baja California Sur festival, triggering a criminal probe in Cabo San Lucas.
articles.body: A festive evening in Baja California Sur turned tragic this week when an 18-year-old woman plunged to the ground from an amusement park ride while it was in motion, triggering a criminal investigation and the replacement of the city's civil protection chief, local outlet Expreso reported. Gabriela Rodríguez Tezoco was riding an attraction called "El Péndulo" ("The Pendulum") at the Cabo San Lucas Traditional Fiestas when she was somehow ejected from her seat while the machine was running as onlookers stood nearby. Emergency personnel, including state investigators and municipal police, rushed to the scene to administer first aid to the young woman, the outlet reported. TOURIST DANGLES 23 STORIES ABOVE STREET IN ‘RECKLESS’ DAREDEVIL STUNT She was evacuated by ambulance to a local hospital but succumbed to her injuries shortly after arriving, according to local reports. "It is with deep sorrow that we announce that the young woman who was injured in the incident that occurred in the mechanical attractions area of the Cabo San Lucas Traditional Festivals, and who was immediately transferred for medical attention, lost her life despite the efforts of the health personnel," the Los Cabos city council said in a Spanish statement, according to a translation. The fatal accident has sparked administrative fallout. Local officials announced the removal of the head of the Municipal Directorate of Civil Protection and Risk Management, according to Mexican news outlets including Opinión Sonora. CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR LIFESTYLE NEWSLETTER An interim director was installed to ensure that investigators have unfettered access to the department's files, safety protocols and operational permits, Expreso reported. Fox News Digital reached out to the local mayor's office, Baja California Sur Public Security and the Los Cabos Transparency Office for additional details. The Baja California Sur State Attorney General’s Office (PGJE) has launched a formal probe to determine liability, local outlets reported. articles.summary: The house may feel quiet and heavy for Sagittarius this Friday.
articles.body: The house may feel quiet and heavy for Sagittarius this Friday. The Moon spends the day in Pisces, your fourth house of home and mother, beside retrograde Shani. When these two meet, astrologers call it Vish yoga, and in the fourth it often shows up as a dull, burdened mood at home. Kantaka Shani, running since March 2025, adds to this. But Friday’s Pradosh offers Shiva’s protection, and “Om Namah Shivaya” is the simplest way to receive it.Vish Yoga in the FourthWith the Moon and Shani together, family members may seem tired or distant. A mother or elder may feel unwell or low. No one may be at fault, and the mood may simply hang in the air.Keep demands light. Offer practical help, such as making tea or tidying a room, rather than starting a serious discussion.The Five-Syllable MantraThe Panchakshari mantra, “Om Namah Shivaya”, is traditionally chanted to ease Shani’s heaviness, since Shiva is honoured as Shani’s guru. Chant it 108 times on a rudraksha mala at Pradosh twilight, or play it softly at home in the evening.Invite family members to join. Chanting together can lift the atmosphere.Jupiter’s ProtectionExalted Jupiter, your ruler, aspects Pisces from your eighth. Its gaze keeps the heaviness from becoming real trouble. Uttara Bhadrapada, the Moon’s nakshatra, also supports deep, quiet devotion.Debilitated Mars beside Jupiter warns against irritation with family.
